title: Page lacks clear visual hierarchy for primary KPIs
rationale: Users should immediately understand the most important information and next analytical step.
review_note: Exploratory pages may intentionally distribute emphasis.

title: Inconsistent spacing, alignment or sizing across visuals
rationale: Consistent layout improves perceived quality and scanability.
review_note: Intentional asymmetry can be valid if it supports hierarchy.

title: Color usage lacks semantic consistency or sufficient restraint
rationale: Consistent semantic color improves comprehension and reduces cognitive load.
review_note: Brand requirements can justify broader palettes.

title: Visual type does not match the analytical question
rationale: Choosing the wrong chart type can obscure or distort the intended comparison/trend.
evidence_required: Visual type, fields, stated business question
review_note: Specialized audiences may prefer domain-specific visuals.

title: Navigation/filter state is difficult to understand
rationale: Users need visible context for filters, page state and navigation.
review_note: Simple single-page reports may not need explicit navigation.

title: Page is overloaded with competing visuals or dense detail
rationale: Overloaded pages reduce comprehension and can also increase query cost.
review_note: Operational monitoring screens may intentionally be dense.
